title: NUBIRAWAVE: Iberchem’s new digital platform to create blooming fragrances with emotional benefits
summary: Following the launch of O-DOOR in 2025, Iberchem continues to integrate data-driven tools into its fragrance creation process, empowering perfumers with greater creativity, flexibility, and precision

extraction.key_fact: Iberchem이 감성 효과를 내는 향 개발을 위한 새 디지털 플랫폼 NUBIRAWAVE를 내놓고 데이터 도구를 조향 과정에 넓히고 있다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Following the launch of O-DOOR in 2025, Iberchem continues to integrate data-driven tools into its fragrance creation process, empowering perfumers with greater creativity, flexibility, and precision
